verdict.rationale: Synctera documents a dedicated Webhook API that lets integrators subscribe to specific platform events, with Synctera pushing updates to the integrator's endpoint rather than the integrator polling (webhooks guide). This is first-party, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, so it clearly delivers the core of the story. missing for 10: details on the event catalog, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, and subscription management mechanics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
